en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tranquil mountain reservoir or pond surrounded by densely forested hills. The water curves gently along a rocky shoreline on the left, with conifer trees and a path or fence line. The valley narrows into the distance between wooded slopes. The top left bears a red title "Goslar. Herzberg-Teich." and the bottom center has a red printer's credit and number: "9759 Brück & Sohn, Meissen".
